SELECT
FROM t_leave l JOIN t_student s ON s.id = l.student_id JOIN t_class cl ON cl.id = s.class_id JOIN t_college cg ON cg.id = cl.college_id WHERE l.id = #{leaveId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_leave l1 JOIN t_student s1 ON s1.id = l1.student_id JOIN t_class c1 ON c1.id = s1.class_id WHERE l1.status = 'PENDING_HEAD' AND c1.head_teacher_id = #{teacherId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_leave l2 JOIN t_student s2 ON s2.id = l2.student_id JOIN t_class c2 ON c2.id = s2.class_id WHERE l2.status = 'PENDING_COUNSELOR' AND c2.counselor_teacher_id = #{teacherId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_leave l3 JOIN t_student s3 ON s3.id = l3.student_id JOIN t_class c3 ON c3.id = s3.class_id JOIN t_college cg3 ON cg3.id = c3.college_id WHERE l3.status = 'PENDING_LEADER' AND cg3.leader_teacher_id = #{teacherId})

SELECT
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_leave l1 JOIN t_student s1 ON s1.id = l1.student_id JOIN t_class c1 ON c1.id = s1.class_id WHERE l1.status = 'PENDING_HEAD' AND c1.head_teacher_id = #{teacherId})
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_leave l2 JOIN t_student s2 ON s2.id = l2.student_id JOIN t_class c2 ON c2.id = s2.class_id WHERE l2.status = 'PENDING_COUNSELOR' AND c2.counselor_teacher_id = #{teacherId})
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_leave l3 JOIN t_student s3 ON s3.id = l3.student_id JOIN t_class c3 ON c3.id = s3.class_id JOIN t_college cg3 ON cg3.id = c3.college_id WHERE l3.status = 'PENDING_LEADER' AND cg3.leader_teacher_id = #{teacherId})

SELECT cg.college_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM t_leave l JOIN t_student s ON s.id = l.student_id JOIN t_class cl ON cl.id = s.class_id JOIN t_college cg ON cg.id = cl.college_id GROUP BY cg.id, cg.college_name
